mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants (merchant_name, merchant_type, rating, total_sales, monthly_sales, min_order_price, delivery_fee, address, phone, business_hours, status) VALUES (#{merchantName}, #{merchantType}, #{rating}, #{totalSales}, #{monthlySales}, #{minOrderPrice}, #{deliveryFee}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{businessHours}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET merchant_name = #{merchantName}, merchant_type = #{merchantType}, rating = #{rating}, total_sales = #{totalSales}, monthly_sales = #{monthlySales}, min_order_price = #{minOrderPrice}, delivery_fee = #{deliveryFee}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, business_hours = #{businessHours}, status = #{status} WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchants WHERE status = 1
SELECT merchant_type AS merchant_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM merchants WHERE status = 1 AND merchant_type IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(merchant_type) != '' GROUP BY merchant_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE merchant_type = #{merchantType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE merchant_name = #{merchantName} LIMIT 1

SELECT merchant_name, rating, total_sales FROM merchants WHERE status = 1 AND rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rating DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT merchant_type, ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avg_rating, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales, COUNT(merchant_id) AS merchant_count FROM merchants WHERE status = 1 AND merchant_type IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(merchant_type) != '' GROUP BY merchant_type ORDER BY total_sales DESC
